blockers.title: Corrupted frontend .next build artifacts
blockers.description: Frontend dev server on :3650 returns 500 errors (missing ./833.js module). Prevents execution of 15/17 browser-based functional tests and user-facing feature verification.
blockers.action: Clean .next directory and restart frontend dev server; re-run browser QA. For TC-09 (chart render), use isolated NEXT_DIST_DIR per dev handoff requirements.
